videos.overview: Brian Pillman joins the broadcast booth as "Stone Cold" Steve Austin steps inside the squared circle. WWE Tag Team Champions The Smoking Gunns are in action. Mr. Perfect sets his sights on Hunter Hearst Helmsley's date.

videos.title: Superstars - Aug. 31, 1996
videos.overview: Brian Pillman interviews "Stone Cold" Steve Austin. Vader takes out his frustration on the competition following his SummerSlam loss. Paul Bearer will lead Mankind to the WWE Championship. Salvatore Sincere faces Aldo Montoya.

videos.title: Superstars - Sep. 07, 1996
videos.overview: Mankind is sick of Shawn Michaels. Hunter Hearst Helmsley takes on Savio Vega. Ahmed Johnson will return when he is ready. Faarooq battles Barry Horowitz. "Stone Cold" Steve Austin steps inside the ring.

videos.title: Superstars - Sep. 22, 1996
videos.overview: Todd Pentengill previews In Your House: Mind Games from Philadelphia. Shawn Michaels and Mankind brawl ahead of their WWE Title Match. Savio Vega looks to topple the massive Vader. The Stalker makes his Superstars debut against The Goon.

videos.title: Superstars - Sep. 29, 1996
videos.overview: WWE Champion Shawn Michaels collides with Justin "Hawk" Bradshaw. Sycho Sid looks to squash Marty Jannetty. "Razor Ramon" has words for Savio Vega. The Sultan is in action.

videos.title: Superstars - Oct 06, 1996
videos.overview: "Diesel" takes on Aldo Montoya. Intercontinental Champion Marc Mero defends his title against Leif Cassidy.

videos.title: Superstars - Oct 13, 1996
videos.overview: The Godwinns clash with The British Bulldog & Owen Hart in tag team action. The Stalker faces off with The Goon.

videos.title: Superstars - Oct 20, 1996
videos.overview: "Razor Ramon" squares off with Bob Holly. Hunter Hearst Helmsley, Goldust, Jake "The Snake" Roberts and Vader are all in singles action.

videos.title: Superstars - Oct 27, 1996
videos.overview: Brian Pillman interviews his former tag team partner "Stone Cold" Steve Austin. Sycho Sid, The Godwinns and Justin Bradshaw are in action.

videos.title: Superstars - Nov 03, 1996
videos.overview: Marc Mero collides with Goldust. "Diesel" & "Razor Ramon" take on Aldo Montoya & Barry Horowitz in tag team action.

videos.title: Superstars - Nov 10, 1996
videos.overview: WWE Champion Shawn Michaels clashes with Salvatore Sincere. Hunter Hearst Helmsley faces Alex Porteau for the Intercontinental Title.

videos.title: Superstars - Nov 17, 1996
videos.overview: Jessie James clashes with The Goon. Billy Gunn battles Bob Holly. "The World's Strongest Man" Mark Henry faces Crush in Tug-of-War.

videos.title: Superstars - Nov 24, 1996
videos.overview: "Stone Cold" Steve Austin faces Bart Gunn. Jessie James battles The Sultan. The Godwinns, The Headbangers and Flash Funk are all in action.

videos.title: Superstars - Dec 01, 1996
videos.overview: Rocky Maivia reacts to his debut at Survivor Series. Crush, The British Bulldog and Owen Hart battle Jake Roberts, Marc Mero and Savio Vega.

videos.title: Superstars - Dec 08, 1996
videos.overview: Bart Gunn challenges Intercontinental Champion Hunter Hearst Helmsley. Rocky Maivia takes on T.L. Hopper.

videos.title: Superstars - Dec 15, 1996
videos.overview: "Stone Cold" Steve Austin faces Barry Windham. Bret Hart and Sycho Sid are interviewed before their WWE Championship Match at In Your House.

videos.title: Superstars - Dec 22, 1996
videos.overview: Diesel and The Undertaker collide in the main event. Owen Hart & The British Bulldog take on Savio Vega & Jesse James.

videos.title: Superstars - Dec 29, 1996
videos.overview: Goldust takes on Leif Cassidy. "Stone Cold" Steve Austin faces two men in a Handicap Match. Vader and Savio Vega meet in the main event.

videos.title: Superstars - Jan 05, 1997
videos.overview: The Undertaker fights The Goon. Relive the premiere of Shotgun Saturday Night, and the face-to-face between Shawn Michaels and Bret Hart.

videos.title: Superstars - Jan 12, 1997
videos.overview: Bret "Hit Man" Hart battles The Sultan. Goldust contends with The Executioner. Ahmed Johnson can't wait to get his hands on Faarooq.

videos.title: Superstars - Jan 19, 1997
videos.overview: Dok Hendrix and Todd Pettengill preview the upcoming WWE Royal Rumble 1997 andrecap Shotgun Saturday Night in San Antonio.

videos.title: Superstars - Jan 26, 1997
videos.overview: Four tag teams battle in the first-ever Superstars Bowl. Intercontinental Champion Hunter Hearst Helmsley takes on Ahmed Johnson.

videos.title: Superstars - Feb 02, 1997
videos.overview: The Undertaker collides with Marc Mero. Vader looks to squash Ced Mann. Relive Savio Vega vs. Jesse James from Shotgun Saturday Night.

videos.title: Superstars - Feb 09, 1997
videos.overview: "Stone Cold" Steve Austin battles Vader as Bret Hart looks on. WWE Champion Shawn Michaels sends a message to his future challengers.

videos.title: Superstars - Feb 16, 1997
videos.overview: Relive Thursday Raw Thursday where a knee injury forces Shawn Michaels to lose his smile and forfeit the WWE Championship.
